maps.name: Inn
maps.description: A modest inn, a place for travels to meet and drink and sometimes find their next adventure.

maps.name: Destroyed Caravan
maps.description: Fires and dead bodies are scattered around broken down wagons. Here and there you see broken Orc weapons and corpses along with piles of human bodies.

maps.name: The Deep Ones Shrine
maps.description: A small shrine dedicated to the only gods left, The Deep Ones
